notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. The package serves one registered state-mode task id, drop_pen_color-state-v0; the other task files under vlm/tasks use the same amsolver.gym.vlmbench_env:VLMBenchEnv wrapper with a different task class and are not packaged (one device class per package). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none; the card's GymnasiumDriver expresses cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. The upstream simulator requires CoppeliaSim 4.1.0 and PyRep (README.md:20) and was neither installed nor run, and package code never imports the clone; the fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in and was never compared with the upstream environment. NOT COVERED: the fake's 29-element state is only the prefix of the real low-dimensional observation (gripper joint positions, gripper touch forces and task_low_dim_state are omitted, and the real length depends on the PyRep gripper and the task); the fake models no task scene, objects, language descriptions, success or reward (it always returns reward 0.0, terminated false and truncated false); vision mode returns 1x1 RGB placeholders instead of the 128x128 default; reset options are accepted and ignored; the sim backend (gymnasium.make(env_id)) additionally needs import amsolver.gym to register the task ids and was not run. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (reset seed, seed seed, step ticks, and the numeric array action.values[*], which mixes seven joint target velocities and one gripper command so no single unit describes it; the bridge derives the schema without a unit). There is no site-limits.example.json because the package declares no operator-required limit. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
